props.name: shape
props.description: Square plate (cos·cos modes) or circular plate (Bessel modes).

props.name: frequency
props.description: Controlled drive frequency in hertz. The nearest eigenmode sets the figure.

props.name: defaultFrequency
props.description: Uncontrolled starting frequency. Defaults to the tenth mode.

props.name: onFrequencyChange
props.description: Called when the slider, the mode buttons or bowing change the frequency.

props.name: playing
props.description: Controlled drive state. Paused, the plate falls quiet and the sand stays where it is.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Called when the play button toggles.

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Start muted. Sound only ever begins from a click on the sound button.

props.name: tone
props.description: Grain colour: the ink token or the accent.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Multiplies how far grains hop. Higher forms figures faster and blurrier.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum width in pixels. The plate is square and fills its container up to this.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the transport, frequency and sound controls.
